content.subject: Specimen Acquisition — OMEGA Priority — MERIDIAN DEPLOYMENT
content.body:
Science Division,

This communication is OMEGA clearance only.

MURDOCH has confirmed viable specimen capture at Sigma Draconis IV survey site (see attached assessment XB-71-PRELIM, not included here).

Specimen is to be transported aboard USCSS Meridian using cover cargo manifest. Container XB-71 environmental specs are attached.

Crew expendability: AUTHORIZED. If specimen containment requires crew elimination, this is sanctioned at the executive level. Do not contact crew regarding the nature of their cargo.

Specimen must arrive at Gateway Station viable. This is a billion-credit acquisition.

Survival of crew: SECONDARY OBJECTIVE.

W-Y Executive Office
Project Prometheus
